topology_notes: Topology: WLC manages AP. Corporate SSID uses WPA2-Enterprise. Laptop configured for WPA2-Personal.
show_outputs:
WLC>show wlan 1
WLAN Identifier.................................. 1
Profile Name..................................... Corporate-WiFi
Network Name (SSID).............................. Corporate-WiFi
Status........................................... Enabled
Security
   802.11 Authentication......................... Open System
   Wi-Fi Protected Access (WPA/WPA2)............. Enabled
      WPA2 (RSN) Encryption...................... AES
      Auth Key Management
         802.1x.................................. Enabled
         PSK..................................... Disabled

Client-Laptop>Wireless Configuration
   SSID: Corporate-WiFi
   Security: WPA2-PSK
   Status: Authentication Failed
expected_fault: Security type mismatch - WLAN uses WPA2-Enterprise (802.1x) but client configured for WPA2-PSK

title: Routing Loop Between Two Routers
symptom: Traceroute shows packets bouncing between R1 and R2 indefinitely. TTL exceeded messages from both routers.
topology_notes: Topology: R1 -- R2 -- R3. Destination 172.16.0.0/16 is on R3.
expected_fault: Routing loop - R1 points to R2 and R2 points back to R1 for 172.16.0.0/16
